c74object.name: lp.poppy
c74object.description: lp.poppy iterates the logistic population growth model. Every bang computes the next population; a float sets the growth rate and bangs, a list sets a cycle of growth rates.

objarg.name: seed
objarg.digest: With two or more numbers: the last is the starting population

method.name: float
method.description: In the left inlet: Growth rates. In the 2nd inlet: Seed population.

method.name: reset
method.digest: Start again at the seed population
method.description: Start again at the seed population.

method.name: set
method.digest: Set the growth rate(s) without output
method.description: Set the growth rate(s) without output.

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).
